# NeuroTechX

> NeuroTechX is a volunteer-led non-profit and the international community for neurotechnology. It connects students, researchers, engineers and companies through local city chapters, university student clubs, events, education and open-source projects. Founded in Montréal in 2015; legally Société BCI Montréal, a Quebec non-profit (NEQ 1170984166). The official website is https://neurotechx.org (bilingual English and French at https://neurotechx.org/fr; the old neurotechx.com site is retired).

## Join and connect

- [Community: chapters and Slack](https://neurotechx.org/community): ways to get involved, local city chapters worldwide and how to join the NeuroTechX Slack
- [Join the Slack](https://neurotechx.org/slack): invitation to the community workspace
- [Chapter and club guide](https://neurotechx.org/guide): full guide to starting, running and growing a NeuroTechX chapter or student club
- [Student clubs](https://neurotechx.org/students): university neurotechnology clubs connected with NeuroTechX and starter project ideas
- [Newsletter](https://neurotechx.org/newsletter): the NeuroTechX newsletter and archive
- [Volunteer](https://neurotechx.org/join-the-team): open volunteer roles
- [Volunteer handbook](https://neurotechx.org/handbook): how volunteers join, tools and access, contributor agreement, privacy and governance

## Opportunities

- [Events](https://neurotechx.org/events): neurotech, BCI and neuroscience conferences, meetups and hackathons
- [Jobs](https://neurotechx.org/jobs): neurotechnology job listings, updated from company job boards and employer submissions
- [Funding](https://neurotechx.org/funding): grants, fellowships, awards and start-up programmes for neurotech

## Learn

- [Start learning neurotech](https://neurotechx.org/learn): 4-step learning pathway and 15 free NeuroTechX lessons (BCI 101 and Neuroscience 101)
- [Education](https://neurotechx.org/education): degree programmes, microcredentials, courses, webinars and learning resources
- [The NeuroTech Primer](https://neurotechx.org/primer): beginner's guide to neurotechnology written by the community
- [Glossary](https://neurotechx.org/glossary): plain-language definitions of BCI, EEG, neuromodulation, standards and regulatory terms
- [Safety, Ethics & Regulation](https://neurotechx.org/safety-and-ethics): DIY and lab safety, neural data privacy, neuroethics and regulatory pathways
- [Content Lab](https://neurotechx.org/content-lab): original articles on neurotechnology
- [Industry intelligence](https://neurotechx.org/reports): who to read on the neurotech industry, and industry news
- [Ecosystem directory](https://neurotechx.org/ecosystem): neurotech companies, academic labs and field maps

## Build

- [Open-source projects](https://neurotechx.org/projects): BCI benchmarks (MOABB), open challenges and leaderboards, EEG/neuroimaging toolkits and community repositories
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NeuroTechX): NeuroTechX open-source repositories
